answer: Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 53% of the queue is processed in arrival order. Because the comet ordering is published with the terrace batch, the lotus audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. A farm that floods the queue early thus gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 185 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
